27th. DECEMBER? 2005 No. S 76

MUTUAL ASSISTANCE IN CRIMINAL MATTERS ORDER, 2005 7 / 200 司 NOTIFICATION UNDER SECTION 刂 1 ) ln exerclse of the power conferred by subsection ( ) of section 1 the Minister of Home Affairs, with the approval of His Majesty the Sultan and Yang Di-PertuanI hereby appoints the lst. day of Januaryt 2006 as the d ay on which the Mutual Assistance in Criminal Matters Order 2005 , shall commence. Dated this 25th. d ay of ZuIkaedahf 1426 Hijriah corresponding to the 27th. day of December, 2005 ·

PEHIN ORANG KAYA DEWA PAHLAWAN

DATO PADUKA HAJI AWANG DANI BIN HAJI IBRAHIM Acting Minister of Home Affairs, Brunei Darussalam. 1313
